title: Fast Algorithm For Solving Time-dependent Multiscale radiative transport Equation
summary: When solving the time-dependent radiative transport equation (RTE), implicit time discretization is often employed for its robustness and stability. This results in a sequence of steady-state RTEs with identical cross-sections but varying source terms, whose repeated solution is computationally costly. To address this, we first apply the adaptive tailored finite point scheme (TFPS) for spatial discretization.
